name: rey-del-arrecife-backend
description: Backend PocketBase y scripts de soporte para Rey del Arrecife

scripts.test: node tests/auth_whitelist.test.js && node tests/inventory_guard.test.js && node tests/user_guard.test.js
scripts.migrate:up: docker compose exec pocketbase pocketbase migrate up --dir=/pb_data --migrationsDir=/pb_migrations
scripts.migrate:snapshot: docker compose exec -i pocketbase pocketbase migrate collections --dir=/pb_data --migrationsDir=/pb_migrations
